nodes.label: PandaCodeGen — the appointed website design & development agency; reuses its own proven house patterns (Next.js, Tailwind, Sanity, Vercel, Resend, consent-gated analytics, structured data, GEO/AI-search) for this build

The mandate (§1.1): rebuild gzfric.com as premium multilingual AI-discoverable commercial platform repositioning FRIC from POSM/product vendor to premium B2B commercial execution partner; replace the legacy jQuery 1.11/Bootstrap 3 site with Next.js + headless CMS

Primary objectives (§1.2): senior-visitor one-screen clarity, serve whole buying centre on every page, win lead quality not raw traffic, be discoverable/citeable by search+AI, ship an extensible system

Definition of success (§1.3): CWV LCP≤2.5s/INP≤200ms/CLS≤0.1, Lighthouse ≥90 [DECIDE: confirm with FRIC], WCAG 2.2 AA, 100% indexation/0 broken links/0 redirect chains, AI-search direct-answer+structured data with GA4 referral tracking, CMS autonomy for new capability/industry/insight/language without engineering

Scope boundaries (§1.4, from spec §04): in-scope IA/design system/all templates/CMS/multilingual EN+ZH/SEO-GEO/analytics/forms-search-downloads-subscription/training/handover; out-of-scope final translation/data migration/proprietary software/customer-supplier portals

Team, roles & responsibilities (§2): Hassan = engagement lead/client contact; Technical lead, CMS/content engineer, Designer, SEO/GEO specialist, QA (all to-assign); FRIC single approver = Anas/Paul; RACI: engineering builds, design specifies the look, SEO owns discoverability, QA gates quality, Hassan owns the client, FRIC approves+supplies inputs

Ways of working (§3): Git trunk-based with short-lived branches + green CI; environments local→preview→staging(noindex)→production; one shared board/visible Gantt; weekly status + formal phase review gates; Definition of Done per ticket; written change control (see §14 of proposal)

The stack, rendering strategy, environments & config (§4): Next.js App Router SSR/SSG/ISR + React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS v4, Sanity headless CMS, Vercel hosting, Resend email, GA4+Search Console consent-gated analytics with AI-referral tracking, server-action forms with honeypot+rate-limit; SSG+ISR for Home/Capability/Industry, server-rendered Contact; env vars incl. SANITY_PROJECT_ID etc. [DECIDE: FRIC's Sanity org/project ownership]; staging noindex+basic-auth, production fully indexable

Repository & project setup — Phase 1-2 groundwork (§5): 10-step scaffold (Git repo owned/transferable to FRIC, Next.js App Router scaffold, folder structure incl. /app/[locale], ESLint/Prettier/Husky, CI, Vercel preview, Sanity project+dataset+Studio [DECIDE: embedded vs standalone], GROQ+revalidation webhook, design-token layer, component playground); exit = green build + Vercel preview + Studio loads

Design system & tokens (§6, from spec §32): white/warm-neutral colour with restrained brand-green accent tokens (--bg/--ink/--muted/--line/--accent), Inter/Inter Display + editorial serif type scale, 4/8px spacing + 12-col grid, subtle reduced-motion-respecting motion, real-commercial-environment imagery; deliverables = token file/type specimen/colour+state/grid reference; minimal iconography policy; component inventory (header/hero variants/content cards/evidence/comparison/CTA/forms/footer)

Content model — Sanity schemas (§7): connected-knowledge-system principle (spec §11); 11 document types (capability/industry/observation/article/whitePaper/framework/caseStudy/newsItem/person/page/siteSettings/redirect) with key fields; every doc has a seo object with answerSummary(GEO)+entity; required related-content fields; localization [DECIDE: field-level internationalizedArray vs document-per-locale — recommend document-per-locale per §35]; editorial workflow Draft→Review→Approved→Scheduled/Published→Archived (§34)

Information architecture & URL structure (§8): primary nav Home|Who We Are|What We Build|Industries|Insights|Contact (§10); URL scheme /{locale}/... short-stable-lowercase-hyphenated (§36); locales en(default)/zh [DECIDE: EN-root vs /en — recommend explicit /en+/zh with x-default→/en]; deliverables = full sitemap×2 locales, journey map, redirect map

Multilingual/i18n implementation (§9, spec §35): locale routing with offer-never-force middleware, document-per-locale Sanity content with independent status, self-referencing canonical + reciprocal hreflang+x-default, language-specific sitemaps, localise everything, locale-scoped internal links, content parity across locales+mobile/desktop (§31 T5), fallback rule [DECIDE: hide-until-approved recommended], real EN/ZH content testing before approval

Page build specifications (§10): build order Home→Marketing Procurement→Industry→Observation→Case/White Paper→Contact then rest; Home(§21) sections+discipline; Who We Are(§22) must-not-become-pain-point-page; Capability×7(§23-24) fixed Hero→Why It Matters→What We Build→How We Build→Proof→Related→Contact with Marketing Procurement(§24) as QA baseline; Industry×4(§25); Insights system(§26) five content families; Proof assets(§27); Contact(§28,§34) one form with auto-captured source; Transitions(§29) one dominant action per section

Component library build (§11, spec §33): build each component in isolation/playground with all states (hover/focus/active/loading/error/success/empty/disabled); requirements = variable title lengths, multilingual expansion, keyboard operability, visible focus, reduced-motion; list = header/menu/switcher/search/anchors/hero(6 variants)/cards(7 variants)/evidence/comparison/CTA/forms/footer

SEO implementation (§12, spec §36): central metadata system from Sanity seo object; one entity+H1/page; server-rendered/SSG critical content; JSON-LD per type (Organization/WebSite/WebPage/BreadcrumbList/Article-BlogPosting+Person/Service-CreativeWork/VideoObject) with example Organization schema; required-field internal linking; automatic XML sitemaps; 301 redirect map from redirect docs; robots.txt+noindex staging; Search Console verification

GEO/AI-search implementation — 'our edge' (§13, spec §37): direct-answer block per money page sourced from answerSummary field; Commercial Observations published as self-contained citeable pages; separate fact/inference/opinion/result; consistent entity naming; semantic HTML not images; crawler policy allow OAI-SearchBot, govern GPTBot independently [DECIDE with FRIC: training opt-in/out]; llms.txt (reuse PandaCodeGen pattern); AI-referral tracking to GA4 (reuse PandaCodeGen referral-classification pattern); gate downloads not explanations; reject 'GEO score' files as a substitute

Performance engineering (§14, spec §38): budget LCP≤2.5s/INP≤200ms/CLS≤0.1 p75, Lighthouse≥90 lab; server components by default + minimal client JS + code-split islands; AVIF/WebP image pipeline; self-hosted/next-font with CJK subset for ZH; CLS elimination from media/embeds/consent banners; deferred third-party scripts (reuse PandaCodeGen interaction-gated loader); ISR+edge caching; CI/preview Lighthouse budget checks

Accessibility (§15, spec §33/§38 — WCAG 2.2 AA): per-component checklist (keyboard/focus/contrast/alt-text/form-labels/reduced-motion/heading-order/skip-link/ARIA/accessible-tables-only-when-essential/locale lang attrs/mobile target sizes); process = axe audit→manual keyboard→SR spot-check→contrast verification; exit = 0 critical/serious issues EN+ZH

Forms, search, downloads, subscription (§16, spec §34): Contact = server action→validation→Resend confirmation+owner notification with captured source/subject/geo (reuse PandaCodeGen audit-lead pattern), honeypot+rate-limit+consent+replay-prevention token; Subscription = email+topic+double opt-in; Downloads = indexable landing page per gated PDF+GA4 download event; Search [DECIDE: Sanity query vs Pagefind static index]

Analytics & measurement (§17, spec §38): GA4+Search Console consent-gated (reuse PandaCodeGen consent provider+deferred loader); 11-event dictionary (page_view/contact_start-submit/file_upload/subscribe/download/video_play/internal_search/carousel_interact/related_click/cta_click/ai_referral); contact_submit marked Key Event/conversion; journey+assisted-conversion tracking; launch dashboard for FRIC's marketing team

Security & compliance (§18, spec §38): HTTPS+secure headers(CSP/HSTS/X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy); protected forms; dependency audit; least-privilege CMS roles; Sanity dataset backup cadence; logs; compliance surfaces (cookie preferences/privacy notice/terms/accessibility statement/anti-spam); consent manager gates analytics/marketing tags

QA & testing plan (§19): test matrix across Functional/Cross-browser/Device/Accessibility/Performance/SEO/i18n/Content-parity/Regression dimensions; process = QA signs each template against acceptance criteria, bugs triaged blocker/major/minor, no blockers/majors open at launch

The six phases — task breakdown (§20): Phase 1 Discovery&IA(~2wk)→Phase 2 Wireframes(~2-3wk)→Phase 3 Visual System(~3wk, 30% payment on approval)→Phase 4 Build&CMS(~4-6wk)→Phase 5 Content&QA(~2-3wk)→Phase 6 Launch&Handover(~1-2wk, final 10% on launch); each with objective/tasks/deliverable/gate

Launch runbook (§21): pre-launch checklist (T-3 days: acceptance criteria/redirect map/structured data/CWV/analytics/security/content-parity/FRIC approval); go-live steps (content freeze→DNS→deploy production remove noindex→activate redirects→submit sitemaps→verify analytics); post-launch T+0-T+14 monitoring (broken links/Search Console/CWV/AI-referral/error logs)

Handover & training (§22): delivered = repos+design tokens+source files+CMS access/roles+documentation+event dictionary+launch dashboard+recorded/live training session; ownership = FRIC owns code/design/content, Sanity/Vercel/domain in FRIC's name, no lock-in

Post-launch stabilisation & care plan (§23): stabilisation window included at launch; optional care plan $800-1,500/mo covering hosting oversight/updates/content support/performance-SEO-AI-crawler monitoring/small enhancements + monthly report (CWV/indexation/AI-referrals/conversions)

Risk register & mitigations (§24): seven risks — content/translation supply slip(High/Schedule), approval turnaround slow(Med/Schedule), unverifiable client claims/logos(Med/Legal-trust, mitigation: publish only FRIC-verified claims per spec §02), ZH typography/layout issues(Med/Quality), scope creep(Med/Cost-time), CWV regressions from media/3rd-party(Med/Perf), CMS mismodelling(Low/Rework)

Assumptions, dependencies & out-of-scope (§25): EN+ZH launch assumed; FRIC supplies approved content/brand assets/verified claims/single approver/reasonable turnaround; dependencies = Sanity/Vercel accounts in FRIC's name+domain access+translations+brand assets; out-of-scope = final translation/data migration/proprietary software/portals; narrative preserved, no change without written approval

Appendices (§26): A.Content inventory template, B.Redirect map template, C.Acceptance checklist master, D.JSON-LD snippet library, E.Event dictionary export, F.Decision log (every [DECIDE] with owner+resolution+date)
[DECIDE] Lighthouse lab targets ≥90 Performance/Accessibility/Best-Practices/SEO — confirm with FRIC (spec leaves exact target 'to be agreed')
[DECIDE] locale URL structure — EN-root vs explicit /en path; recommendation: explicit /en+/zh with x-default→/en for clean hreflang

[DECIDE] technical implementation choices: Sanity Studio embedded at /studio vs standalone; search = Sanity-backed query vs Pagefind static index; localization = field-level internationalizedArray vs document-per-locale (recommend document-per-locale)
[DECIDE with FRIC] GPTBot training opt-in/out — governed independently from OAI-SearchBot (search) crawler permission
[DECIDE] fallback rule for missing translations — recommend hide-until-approved over show-EN-with-notice, to avoid mixed-language pages
